articles.headline: Volkswagen Pulls Rivals Into $1.2 Billion India Tax Dispute
articles.brief: Volkswagen has drawn competitors Mercedes and BMW into a massive $1.2 billion tax dispute in India, intensifying regulatory pressures for luxury automakers operating in the fast-growing South Asian market.

articles.headline: Global Fashion Brands Shift Orders From Bangladesh to India
articles.brief: Amid ongoing unrest in Bangladesh, major international fashion brands are redirecting their supply chain orders toward India to ensure stability and avoid severe delivery delays in the upcoming apparel seasons.

articles.headline: Verizon in Advanced Talks Over $6 Billion Fidium Deal
articles.brief: Telecom major Verizon is reportedly in advanced acquisition talks regarding a $6 billion deal for Fidium, according to Financial Times reports, signaling aggressive expansion within fiber and broadband services.

articles.headline: Software Giant SAP Weighs Major Job Cuts Amid AI Shift
articles.brief: Enterprise software leader SAP is reportedly considering significant workforce reductions as artificial intelligence rapidly transforms the technology sector, forcing companies to restructure operations and prioritize automation capabilities.

articles.headline: Indian Central Bank Allows Rupee Rise to Break Depreciation Bets
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India has permitted the local currency to appreciate slightly, a strategic move aimed at breaking persistent one-way bets on rupee depreciation in foreign exchange markets.

articles.headline: Cabinet Approves Bill for 50% More Lok Sabha Seats
articles.brief: The Union Cabinet has approved a constitutional amendment bill proposing a roughly 50 percent increase in Lok Sabha seats for all states, alongside a freeze on seat proportions until 2051.

articles.headline: Makkah Alliance Countries Review Regional Security Situation
articles.brief: Member nations of the Makkah alliance convened to review evolving regional security dynamics, strongly condemning recent Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia while reaffirming commitments to collective regional stability.

articles.headline: Hamas Says Israel Attempted to Assassinate Chief’s Son
articles.brief: Hamas security sources reported that an Israeli assassination attempt targeted the youngest surviving son of Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya in Gaza, resulting in targeted structural damage and casualties.

articles.headline: US Pushed Venezuela and Iraq to Quit OPEC to Boost Oil
articles.brief: A new report reveals that the United States exerted diplomatic pressure on both Venezuela and Iraq earlier this year regarding their OPEC memberships, attempting to open pathways to boost global oil production.

articles.headline: Bangladesh Eyes ICJ to Secure Sheikh Hasina Extradition
articles.brief: The Bangladeshi government is actively considering pursuing legal avenues at the International Court of Justice to secure the extradition of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina from India following her flight.

articles.headline: Dell Reports Record Revenue Driven by Surging AI Demand
articles.brief: Dell Technologies announced record third-quarter financial results with revenue reaching $54.9 billion, fueled by a massive surge in AI server demand and a strong backlog valued at over $132 billion.

articles.headline: India Textile Exporters Rush Shipments to Beat 25% Tariff
articles.brief: Indian textile exporters are scrambling to accelerate cargo shipments to the United States ahead of proposed sweeping tariff changes, aiming to protect profit margins against potential trade headwinds.

articles.headline: New Zealand Lower Order Rallies in Second Test Against India
articles.brief: New Zealand's lower-order batsmen staged a resilient fightback during the second Test match, frustrating Indian bowlers despite impressive bowling spells from Akash Deep and Jasprit Bumrah on a lively pitch.

articles.headline: Rohit Sharma Returns as Mumbai Indians Captain for IPL 2027
articles.brief: In a major roster shakeup, the Mumbai Indians franchise announced the return of veteran batsman Rohit Sharma as team captain for the upcoming 2027 Indian Premier League season following a three-year gap.
